verdict.rationale: Aircall's own pricing page says it routes incoming calls with a keypad menu (IVR) so callers reach the right team, which matches the 'press 1 for sales' story and adds business-hours scheduling. The smart-routing and overflow tutorials are developer-built code rather than the admin capability itself, so they earn no credit here. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on building and configuring IVR menus (menu levels, key-to-team mapping), independent or hands-on confirmation.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can build a phone menu (press 1 for sales) that routes callers to teams

citations.quote: Route incoming calls automatically using a keypad menu (IVR) so callers can reach the right team, combined with business-hours scheduling
